quizName:
Hardest Questions in Texas
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: You should slow down in which situations?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, where there are pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Vehicles must have liability insurance:

options.text: Only when used on an interstate.
Only when operated by a minor.

questions.explanation: All vehicle owners and drivers must have at least the minimum liability insurance. This protects against costs from injuries or property damage caused while driving.

questions.question: You missed your exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane.
Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway. Continue to the next exit or location where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect your driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows reaction time, coordination, and balance. It also harms your judgment and vision. You may feel overconfident, which is dangerous while driving.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even when no traffic is nearby.
Signal only if there is visible traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even when no traffic is nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. This is required by law.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must focus completely on driving. Any activity that takes attention away from driving is dangerous.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When should you slow down and stay farther behind other cars?
questions.explanation: Slow down and increase your following distance when roads are wet, traffic is heavy, or visibility is poor. Always be able to stop within the distance you can see ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: When turning left on green, let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to wait for oncoming traffic and only turn when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: Is street racing ever legal?
questions.explanation: Street racing is illegal at all times. High speeds make it impossible for drivers to avoid hazards and respond safely, often causing serious crashes and injuries.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your driving ability?

options.text: It affects your ability to think clearly.

questions.explanation: Alcohol reduces judgment, reaction time, vision, thinking ability, and concentration. These are all essential for safe driving.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. A train or other vehicle may be using the tracks.

questions.question: Who must wear a safety belt in a car?
questions.explanation: All drivers and passengers must wear safety belts in Texas if the vehicle has them. This law applies to everyone, no matter their age.

questions.question: What can make a person unable to drive safely?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and being tired can all make it harder to drive safely.

questions.question: You are angry after something at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play loud radio music to stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release anger.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop at a bar and drink before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait to calm down before driving. Acting out emotions while driving is dangerous and shows poor judgment. It puts you and others at risk.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel

questions.explanation: Anything that takes your attention away from driving, your eyes off the road, or your hands off the wheel is a distraction that can cause a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: Do not pass another vehicle:

options.text: In a curve in the road
Where you cannot see far ahead

questions.explanation: Do not pass on hills, in curves, or where visibility is limited. Only pass where it is legal and safe to do so.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry because all cars are the same
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with it
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend
Take a few minutes to learn how the car's controls work before driving

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn how the car's controls work before driving
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, find and test the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for signs of an oncoming train.
